method: Loaded actual IGN/OSM game, demand-only user gesture, actual Soundscape contexts and realtime audio nodes. Graphics held for these audio lifecycle tests. Three profiles, three mapped habitats, panned river, rare-road camera guard, audio toggle/visibility/volume, 12 disposals and one intentionally failed asset request. Not human listening.
